plan.h: The cliffhanger: four options (you asked for a conversation)
items: A (in the cut, your idea): the President calls straight back and wants her in the Situation Room as soon as possible; Karen shocked; To be continued.

B (the voicemail): the President rings Karen's mobile. Cut to her phone at the bottom of the river, lighting up: 'The person you have called is not available. Please leave a message after the tone.' He has to call the phone box instead. It pays off the throw and your voicemail line.
C (Sean is listening): the call to the Situation Room is answered by Sean's robot voice: 'Please hold.' The machine now runs the switchboard. It's a darker hook for the next episode.
D (Karen's terms): shocked, Karen pauses, then: 'Mmm. Hold, please.' She puts the President on hold. It's the comedy ending, and it uses Jack's sting as the punchline.
My pick: A, with D's sting on the end card (it's still there now). B is the best callback if you want one more beat.
